Description:
Uni Desk is a professional workstation and media automation studio engineered specifically for high-throughput video editors, wedding studios, and digital post-production facilities.

Built to streamline heavy Adobe Premiere Pro and Media Encoder workflows, Uni Desk eliminates repetitive manual tasks, file browsing bottlenecks, and overnight render crashes.

KEY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Zero-Click Domino Pipeline: Chain Media Encoder rendering directly into Title Adder and Converter. Batch-rendered video sequences and photos automatically rename and organize into destination folders without requiring a single click.
• Sub-Millisecond XML Sequence Locator: Instantly resolve Premiere Pro sequence XMLs across multi-terabyte project bins and recent project caches in under 1 millisecond.
• Intelligent Ceremony & Nikah Detection: Smart ceremony recognition in Premiere Pro CEP extensions identifies marker naming formats and executes multi-track downstream ripple insertion with zero footage cut.
• Archive Vault & Safar Reconciliation: Root-level drive scanning, multi-tier project backup, and SHA-256 bit-for-bit integrity validation to safeguard valuable event footage.
• Native Completion Chimes & Desktop Alerts: Receive distinct 4-tone celebration shimmer chimes and native Windows notifications when overnight batch jobs finish.
• Resilient File Handling: Exponential backoff retries and non-blocking background workers permanently prevent transient Windows and OneDrive EBUSY lock crashes.
ReleaseNotes:
• Cross-Platform Release Studio: Automated production engine supporting high-speed NSIS packaging.
• Live Obsidian Build Terminal: Real-time high-contrast build console with syntax highlighting.
• Enhanced Nikah Ceremony Detection: Multi-track ripple placement for complex marker formats.
• Sub-millisecond XML Sequence Locator across all Premiere Pro CEP extensions.
• Fixed startup update prompt semver checks and suppressed transient EBUSY file locks.
Features: Zero-Click Domino Pipeline chaining Adobe Media Encoder into Title Adder and Converter
Sub-millisecond Premiere Pro sequence XML locator across multi-terabyte project bins
Intelligent Nikah and ceremony marker recognition with downstream ripple placement
Archive Vault with root-level drive scanning and SHA-256 bit-for-bit integrity verification
Automated camera and video card transfer with organized folder structuring
4-tone celebration completion chime and native Windows 11/10 desktop notifications
Resilient EBUSY file-lock suppression for uninterrupted overnight batch rendering
Cloud synchronization portal integrated with Google Drive and enterprise network storage
ShortDescription: Professional workstation and media automation toolkit for Adobe Premiere Pro and studio video production.
